blocks.text: Cloverdale homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Cloverdale, September 2026. Detached houses: 167 listed at month end and 22 sold in September, a sales ratio of 13% (a balanced market). Condos and townhomes: 98 listed at month end and 17 sold in September, a sales ratio of 17% (a balanced market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, detached houses sold 100 over 4 months against an average of 164.8 listed, about 6.6 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 29 sold. condos and townhomes sold 69 over 4 months against an average of 104.2 listed, about 6.0 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 19 sold.
